projectTitle: notehub-js: JavaScript client for the Blues Notehub API
description: notehub-js, published on npm as @blues-inc/notehub-js, is the JavaScript client library for the Blues Notehub REST API at https://api.notefile.net, generated from the Notehub OpenAPI specification. It provides Promise-based API classes and models for Notehub projects, devices, fleets, events, routes, environment variables, firmware updates, monitors, jobs, and usage data.
rules: Install with npm install @blues-inc/notehub-js and import that scoped name, e.g. import * as NotehubJs from "@blues-inc/notehub-js". The package ships no TypeScript declarations; in TypeScript, add declare module "@blues-inc/notehub-js".

Authorize Notehub API requests to https://api.notefile.net with an Authorization: Bearer header carrying a Notehub personal access token or an OAuth bearer token. In notehub-js, set ApiClient.instance.authentications["personalAccessToken"].accessToken.

Create API classes with new NotehubJs.DeviceApi(), new NotehubJs.ProjectApi(), new NotehubJs.EventApi(), and so on. Each uses the shared NotehubJs.ApiClient.instance unless you pass an ApiClient to its constructor.

notehub-js methods are camelCase and return Promises. Pass required path parameters positionally and optional parameters in a trailing opts object, e.g. new NotehubJs.DeviceApi().getDevices(projectOrProductUID, { pageSize: 50, pageNum: 1 }).

Devices, Notes, Notefiles, and device environment variables are in DeviceApi; fleets, products, firmware, DFU, and project environment variables are in ProjectApi; events are in EventApi; routes are in RouteApi.

Paged methods such as getDevices take pageSize and pageNum options. Responses keep the API's snake_case keys: read data.has_more, and pass data.next_cursor from EventApi.getEventsByCursor as the next call's cursor option (not hasMore or nextCursor).

Copy Api class, method, parameter, and model names exactly from this SDK's src/docs files or the Notehub API reference (https://dev.blues.io/api-reference/notehub-api/); do not invent methods, parameters, or response fields.
